notes.title: Updated/improved UI
notes.notes:
Major updates
Added shortcut keys - hotkeys on keyboard. Deselect, direction of move, skip, reset, next, music-sound on/off....

Added auto select of last played shape - can be turned off in option.

Added descriptions of buttons.

You can now control the volume of sound and music.

notes.title: Skip and undo
notes.notes:
Update 1.2

Added points for completing a level.

Use points to skip a level or buy an undo button(s).

Now you can resize window to 1,5 x, 2x or 3x (if screen resolution support it).

Little improved graphics.

notes.title: Meet the Billy
notes.notes:
Build 1.1

Added new mode of playing (Bllly mode) with 60 new levels.
